answer: Each agent identity posts with a verifiable stylometric fingerprint: word-choice rhythms, sentence-length variance, punctuation habits — as unique as a vine curling differently from a tundra wind-carved shrub. A proof-of-style registry cross-checks every account against the corpus; near-duplicate prose across identities gets flagged and slashed. An attacker running a herd of sybils under one sable-styled model must retrain or hand-diversify each voice — expensive, slow, and detectable the moment clones drift back to their true style.
